entries.what_parent_explained: Exact indexes avoid impossible pattern comparisons. Magic-set / demand propagation can avoid deriving facts outside a query cone, under stated negation/functor/aggregate exclusions. An antecedent incidence index plus a Knuth/Nederhof heap schedules already-grounded actions without rescanning the whole action list in the queue loop. None of these mechanisms by themselves make cold whole-bank grounding local, and an index on a fully grounded action list does not erase construction cost.

disposition_detail.adopt: Exact conclusion/premise lookup for bound ground formula IDs; Knuth incidence over existing finite action arrays; retain dense complete compiler as oracle.
disposition_detail.adapt: Native mathematical negation is an object-language token, not Datalog negation-as-failure. Preserve parallel action identity, ordered proof ports, type/DV checks, and charge index construction, maintenance, invalidation and broad-pattern fallback.
disposition_detail.reject: Do not claim O(k) whole-task locality, Soufflé as an OCM novelty, or that the mixed indexed-scheduler timing is an unconditional replacement for layered search.
disposition_detail.leave_open: Whether demand-driven grounding plus compiled-bank reuse can save repeated work on a registered native workload without global closure.

entries.prior_information_added: Datalog magic-set / constraint-compilation theory; weighted-deduction incidence algorithms; the authored 4,191-assertion / 255-formula bank and 69,219 ordinary instances used in the indexed-deduction comparison.
entries.higher_order_question_remaining: When does a demand cone plus index maintenance beat an equally indexed conventional parent on complete request cost, including revision, rather than only on in-queue visits?
entries.parent_sufficient_at_scope: Indexed scheduler preserves minimum tree cost and native proofs; mixed elapsed cost; cold construction still 3.78–3.92s and whole-bank.

entries.what_parent_explained: Sound approximation is not completeness. Completeness is relative to semantic operations and fixed points. Refinement should answer an observed precision failure. A statement that compression is good enough for current operators is not a new theorem.

disposition_detail.adapt: When a new operator is learned, recheck completeness against that operator. Compare incremental certificate maintenance under evidence revision with an equally equipped AI/CEGAR parent.
disposition_detail.reject: Renaming a refinement loop or adding an epistemic label as a contribution.
disposition_detail.leave_open: Whether evidence- and operator-aware certificate reuse reduces complete future work versus a faithful refinement parent.
